title: extend_query_with silently drops existing query parameters with blank values
property: extending a query keeps all existing key/value pairs, including those with empty values, and appends the new ones
actual: query == 'b=c' (the existing 'a=' is lost); extending with [] turns 'a=' into ''
evidence: Docstring: 'Extend the existing query string with the new query items.' Existing items are parsed with parse_qsl(self.query) without keep_blank_values=True, so blank-valued params are discarded; extension should only add, never remove.
